purpose: Defines how in-game/editor world paint operations are persisted as deterministic operation records for save, replay, migration, and multiplayer synchronization.
rules: World paint operations are logged as operation deltas, not raw rendered pixels.
The host/server owns authoritative paint operations in multiplayer.
Clients derive visual overlays deterministically from tile/material IDs and manifests.
Subcell masks are detail/paint/blend data inside a 32x32 gameplay tile, not separate gameplay tiles by default.
Generated/autotile visual refresh can be replayed after the authoritative material delta is applied.

mirrorRules.horizontal: mirror across canonical scene X axis: mirrored_x = scene_width - 1 - x
mirrorRules.vertical: mirror across canonical scene Y axis: mirrored_y = scene_height - 1 - y
mirrorRules.both: four-way mirrored paint strokes are deduplicated when centers overlap
mirrorRules.authority: host/server stores mirror flags and resolved center list with the paint delta operation
